snippet.title: KEYRIN LOVES YOU - A first person dungeon crawler / typing game based on poetry!
snippet.description:
Download the demo on itch.io https://d-mag.itch.io/keyrin-loves-you?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt A section of the upcoming game THREE VERSES³.

THREE VERSES is a first person dungeon crawler / typing game based on poetry. Having shed your corporeal form, you must now escape purgatory by completing the simple task of delivering verses from deities to struggling poets.

➡️ More from sphere https://d-mag.itch.io/?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt
➡️ More adventure games https://itch.io/games/genre-adventure?ac=qfCyYFQF-yt
